title: Subtraction within 10,000
introduction: Develop Primary 3 skills in subtraction within 10,000.
definition: Subtract corresponding digits from right to left, regrouping from a higher place when necessary. If a place contains zero, regroup across it. Verify by adding the difference to the subtrahend.

formulas.expression: a − b = c ⇔ c + b = a

examples.question: Calculate 7,002 − 3,568.
steps: Regroup across the zeros: 12 ones, 9 tens, 9 hundreds, 6 thousands.

exercises.solution: Regroup ones and hundreds as needed.

exercises.question: A shop has 5,120 items and sells 1,875. Remaining?
